title: You're Probably Paying For Subscriptions You Forgot About

scenes.heading: Quick question
lines: How much do you spend on subscriptions every month? Guess. Right now.

scenes.heading: Most people say...
lines: In one survey, most people guessed around eighty six dollars.

scenes.heading: The real number
lines: The real number? Over two hundred dollars. Every. Single. Month.

scenes.heading: Where it hides
lines: The free trial you forgot to cancel. The app you opened once. The second streaming service.

scenes.heading: Per year
lines: That gap alone can cost you over a thousand dollars a year.

scenes.heading: Tonight
lines: So tonight, open your bank app and scroll through last month's charges.

scenes.heading: Ask one thing
lines: For each one, ask: would I sign up for this again today?

scenes.heading: No? Cut it.
lines: If the answer is no, cancel it. Right there. No guilt.

scenes.heading: Your turn
lines: Tell me in the comments how many you found. Follow for one simple money move every day!
